decisions.reason: The spring-controlled flap weir sits close to the firm's core hydraulic steelwork business, so keeping it costs little, and after only one year its market value is still uncertain, which favors keeping the option open.

The energy management system fits the firm's strategic direction toward digital networking and energy recovery, so it is a valuable growth option, although earlier software-type launches were dropped quickly, which adds some risk.
The overflow flap gate line has several models and a dedicated web page, which signals that the firm has already committed further to it and that its early results look positive.
